title: feat: add Claude Opus 5.5 fast mode via OpenRouter
author: tomdacatto

gist.summary: Adds the paid-only `anthropic/claude-opus-5.5:fast` model, with input, cache-read, cache-write, and output pricing per 1M tokens. It routes OpenRouter’s `anthropic/claude-opus-5.5` through the pinned `anthropic/fast` endpoint, with no standard-speed fallback that could charge fast-mode rates for standard-speed service. The model accepts text and images, supports tool calling, and uses the standard Opus 5.5 parameters without forcing tool choice.
